name: Sika® Ceram-90
description:
DESCRIPTION
Sika®Ceram-90 PK is a cementitious, non-shrink, polymer containing, thin bed tile adhesive used for permanent fixing of tiles, suitable for tropical and hot climatic conditions.

CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES
▪ High bond strengths
▪ Easy to use, just add water
▪ Excellent workability
▪ Excellent pot life
▪ Can be applied directly on cement screeds, concrete, or lime mortars
▪ Non-Toxic
▪ Suitable for indoor and outdoor application

USES
Sika®Ceram-90 PK is suitable for fixing:
▪ Wall and floor tiles
▪ Insulation and acoustic tiles
▪ Marbles and terrazzo tiles
▪ Mosaics
